title: SM-ACC-005E: atomic internal service receipts and AR settlement
authority: Owner instruction 2026-11-16: تمام نكمل, continue the previously recommended next bounded receipts step; no merge or deployment requested at this stage.
scope: Record bounded operator-declared partial/full SAR receipts against one immutable internal service charge, with request replay, atomic journal/subledger, receivable balance and SQL reconciliation.
out_of_scope: ZATCA/fiscal issuance, third-party or bank verification, refunds, corrections, provider settlement, multi-currency, merchant UI, native POS, release or production deployment.
task: Implement ADR 0023 and Issue #42 against exact source, independently of terminal/shift/stock.
validation: PostgreSQL/API/SQL tests for decimal, partial/full, replay/overpay/concurrency, immutable SQL, tenant grants, audit rollback and migration cycle; Foundation, Accounting Web and Governance CI, full-diff review.
stop_conditions: Official main mismatch; conflicting PR; any failed/unreviewed exact-head check; unreconciled customer AR or ledger; external payment or fiscal claims; attempted production deployment.
success_criteria: Every receipt is a single durable operator-declared settlement of existing charge AR; total receipts cannot exceed gross and every receipt has one exact immutable balanced journal; no duplicate effects or cross-tenant access.
